headline: FBT and IBB Are Not the Same Biotech Bet, and 5 Years of Returns Prove It
summary: Most biotech investors treat FBT and IBB as two names for the same trade, but the structural differences buried in their index methodologies have produced shockingly different outcomes depending on where the market's momentum actually lives.
